name: 01 - Daily Competitor ATS Hiring & Google Ads Spend Slack Alert (RevClamp)

parameters.content:
## Daily Competitor ATS Hiring & Google Ads Spend Alert

**1. Instant Zero-Key Test (Works Out-of-the-Box with Zero Credentials):**
Click **Test workflow** right now. Both `RevClamp Hiring Watchlist (Preview Diff)` (`demoMode: true`) and `Google Ads Transparency Lookup` (`demo: true`) run live against `https://revclamp.com` with zero API keys, and `Zero-Key Demo Output (Slack Block Kit Preview)` renders the formatted Slack Block Kit JSON cleanly.

**2. Switch to Live 24/7 Competitor Monitoring:**
- Provision a free workspace key (`rg_live_YOUR_WORKSPACE_KEY`) at `https://revclamp.com/tools/ats-hiring-watchlist`.
- On `Configure Target & Slack Webhook`, paste your Slack Incoming Webhook URL (`https://hooks.slack.com/services/<TEAM_ID>/<BOT_ID>/<WEBHOOK_KEY>`) into `slackWebhookUrl`.
- On `RevClamp Hiring Watchlist (Preview Diff)`, set `demoMode` to `false` and connect your `revClampApi` credential (or add the `RevClamp TalentPulse Watchlist Trigger` node for event-driven polling).
- On `Google Ads Transparency Lookup`, add header `Authorization: Bearer rg_live_YOUR_WORKSPACE_KEY` and set `demo: false`.
